I decided to take a short break from work to sort through some things."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That sounds like a wise decision. Sometimes stepping back can really help clear the mind. It was a huge surprise, and honestly, I'm really struggling with it."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I'm so sorry to hear that, especially since you were expecting it. That must be incredibly frustrating and disappointing."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Yeah, it's just a mix of feeling both relieved and extremely disappointed. I guess I had my hopes up about the new opportunity."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It's completely normal to have mixed emotions, especially with something as significant as a career move. It's okay to feel both sides of it."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Thank you for saying that. It feels like my career growth isn't going as planned, and that's adding to my stress."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That's understandable, Jane. It can be very challenging to feel stagnated, especially when you've put in so much effort. How are you coping with the stress?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I guess I'm just trying to take things one day at a time. I started a journal a while back to track my thoughts and emotions, and that's been somewhat helpful."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Journaling is a fantastic way to process emotions. Yes, in some ways it helps, but I still feel stuck. It's like writing doesn't change the actual situation I'm in.
